mapper.select: select r.role_code from admin_user_roles ur join admin_roles r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.is_delete = 0 where ur.admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} and ur.is_delete = 0 and r.role_status = 'ACTIVE' order by r.role_code
mapper.insert: insert into admin_user_roles (created_time, updated_time, is_delete, relation_id, admin_user_id, role_id, granted_by, granted_time) values (#{grantedTime}, #{grantedTime}, 0, #{relationId}, #{adminUserId}, #{roleId}, null, #{grantedTime}) on conflict (admin_user_id, role_id) where is_delete = 0 do nothing
